node -e "const { Kafka } = require('kafkajs'); const k = new Kafka({ clientId: 'topic-setup', brokers: (process.env.KAFKA_BROKERS || 'localhost:29092').split(',') }); const admin = k.admin(); const topics = ['instance.requested','instance.terminate','instance.schedule.requested','instance.scheduled','instance.provision.failed','instance.provisioned','instance.termination.requested','instance.terminated','instance.status.changed','instance.failed','worker.heartbeat','worker.node.unhealthy']; admin.connect().then(() => admin.createTopics({ topics: topics.map(t => ({ topic: t, numPartitions: 3, replicationFactor: 1 })), waitForLeaders: true })).then(() => { console.log('Topics created:', topics); return admin.disconnect(); }).catch(e => { console.error('Failed:', e.message); process.exit(1); });"
